text: Review pull requests and merge code from a phone while on the go
quote: Whether you're reviewing a bug fix or merging code, we've got you covered. From your daily commute to grabbing a coffee, unblock your team on the go.

text: Get notified about actions that need your attention from anywhere
quote: Stay informed on actions that require your attention from anywhere.

text: Start, manage, and track progress of Copilot cloud agent tasks from the mobile app
quote: Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are. Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress while you’re on the move.

text: Copilot code review analyzes pull requests and suggests improvements from your phone
quote: Let Copilot code review analyze your pull requests and suggest improvements right from your phone.

text: Assign issues to Copilot to get a ready-to-review PR, then refine via comments, approve, and merge in the app
quote: Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.

text: Ask Copilot in natural language to explain code, guide through codebases, give repo insights, and open a pull request
quote: Ask Copilot to break down complex coding concepts, guide you through unfamiliar codebases, provide insights into both public and your private repositories, and open a new pull request – all in natural language.

text: Global code search to locate code snippets and navigate repositories from the home screen
quote: Effortlessly locate code snippets, navigate repositories, and access content directly from your home screen with global code search.

text: Triage and manage GitHub work from a mobile device
quote: Triage, collaborate, and manage your work on GitHub from your mobile device.

text: Mobile app supports tablet layouts, such as a pull request list on tablet
quote: one is a tablet screen and the other two are phone screens. The tablet screen shows a list of pull requests

text: Available as an iOS app download
quote: Download for iOS

text: Copilot on GitHub.com answers repo questions, plans and makes changes, reviews PRs, and automates repository tasks
quote: GitHub Copilot on GitHub.com can answer questions about your repositories, plan and make changes, review pull requests, and automate repository tasks.

text: Automations run repository tasks on a schedule or in response to events without new prompts
quote: Automations run repository tasks on a schedule or in response to events, rather than requiring a new prompt each time.

text: Copilot review feedback includes suggested changes you can apply in a couple of clicks
quote: Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.

text: Auto model selection routes each task to the optimal AI model
quote: Auto model selection routes the task to the optimal model.

text: Copilot supports multiple AI models with different strengths in speed, cost, reasoning, or multimodal input
quote: GitHub Copilot supports multiple AI models, each with different strengths. Some prioritize speed and cost-efficiency, while others are optimized for accuracy, reasoning, or multimodal inputs.

text: Buy additional credits after using up plan-included credits
quote: If you use up all of the credits included in your plan, you can purchase more and keep working.

text: Create specialized custom agents for specific development tasks and invoke them from IDE chat
quote: You can create specialized agents with tailored expertise for specific development tasks, and invoke them from chat in your IDE.

text: Official GitHub MCP server lets Copilot Chat interact with repositories, issues, and pull requests
quote: use the GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests, and other GitHub features, directly from Copilot Chat in your IDE

text: Connect external MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications
quote: Connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications.

text: GitHub CLI brings pull requests, issues, Actions, and other GitHub features to the terminal
quote: GitHub CLI is a command-line tool that brings pull requests, issues, GitHub Actions, and other GitHub features to your terminal

text: Attach local images and videos to issues, PRs, and comments from the command line
quote: Attach local images and videos to issues, pull requests, and comments without leaving the command line.

text: Copilot CLI lets you use Copilot directly from the terminal
quote: The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.

text: Copilot extension for Azure Data Studio gives coding suggestions as you type
quote: Installing the GitHub Copilot extension in Azure Data Studio allows you to receive coding suggestions from Copilot as you type.

text: Setting to allow or block Copilot suggestions that match public code
quote: Your personal settings for GitHub Copilot include an option to either allow or block code suggestions that match publicly available code.

text: GitHub Actions automates, customizes, and runs software development workflows in your repository
quote: Automate, customize, and execute your software development workflows right in your repository with GitHub Actions.

text: GitHub REST API for building integrations, retrieving data, and automating workflows
quote: Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.

text: GitHub GraphQL API lets you specify exactly the data you want to fetch
quote: The GitHub GraphQL API offers flexibility and the ability to define precisely the data you want to fetch.

text: Free plan includes limited access to a selection of Copilot features
quote: This plan includes limited access to a selection of Copilot features allowing you to try AI-powered coding assistance at no cost.
